en: ___ do you live? – In a house by the park.
The answer is a place, so we ask “Where”.
___ is at the door? – It is Grandma.
The answer is a person, so we ask “Who”.
The answer is a time, so we ask “When”.
___ are you smiling? – Because I got a present.
The answer gives a reason, so we ask “Why”.
___ do you get to school? – By bus.
The answer tells us the way, so we ask “How”.
___ is in your lunchbox? – A banana.
The answer is a thing, so we ask “What”.
Which word asks about a time?
“When” asks about a time, like “When is lunch?”
Which word asks about a person?
“Who” asks about a person, like “Who is she?”
___ many legs does an octopus have? – Eight.
___ did you put my book? – On the shelf.
The answer is a place, so we ask “Where”.

example.q_en: ___ do you live? – In a house by the park.
example.why_en: The answer is a place, so we ask “Where”.

en.title: Question words
en.teach: Question words start a question. Who asks about a person, what about a thing, where about a place, when about a time, why about a reason and how about the way: Where is my hat?
